integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained up to a standard finite-state Markov additive-functional CLT; the included exact checker corroborates finite cases without being a proof for all n.
scientific_limitations: The exact runs law holds for all finite lengths, but the combined-test power bound is asymptotic and a union upper bound, not equality. Only the specified cyclic stationary three-state Markov family is treated; historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Cyclic Markov dependence defeats a combined runs–frequency test
